text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up, onboarding sylph4b-q8n into the eval harness is hitting a weird tokenizer/collate combo when using our multiline chat_template sentinel. Runner throws during collate stage and CI marks the job as flaky.
Aron Patel: Can you paste the minimal repro + the template you used?
Mia Chen: Yep — template has a system message with a "<SYS>\n...\n</SYS>" sentinel. Repro command: `python tools/eval_runner.py --model=sylph4b-q8n --suite=llm-eval --template=tests/templates/sylph_multisys.json`
Mia Chen: Paste from runner log (truncated):
```\n2026-03-19 14:02:01,234 runner ERROR CollateError: prefix tokenization mismatch\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File "runner/collate.py", line 142, in collate_batch\n    token_ids = tokenizer.encode(prefix, add_special_tokens=False)\n  File "tokenizers/wrapper.py", line 58, in encode\n    raise ValueError(f"Token not in vocab: {tok}")\nValueError: Token not in vocab: <SYS>\nDuring handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:\n  File "runner/main.py", line 301, in run_eval\n    collated = collate_batch(requests)\nCollateError: failed to collate batch: sentinel token missing in token map\n```\nSamir Ortiz: That looks like the sentinel `<SYS>` isn't present in the tokenizer special_tokens for the quantized artifact. Did we run the tokenizer postprocess step when exporting q8_nop-run?
Riley Torres: @Samir good call — the quant export job used `--strip-specials` to reduce vocab; it shouldn't have for chat templates that rely on sentinels.
Aron Patel: Short-term workaround: runner can fallback to `tokenizer.encode_bytes` when a sentinel is missing, but that will shift token counts and break exact eval parity. Longer-term we need consistent special_tokens.json baked into the model bundle.
Eval CI Bot: build #4782 failed: eval-runner / sylph4b-q8n / tests/templates/sylph_multisys.json — CollateError
Mia Chen: I pushed a small patch to add a pre-check in the eval harness that validates all template sentinels exist in tokenizer.special_tokens and fails fast with a clear message. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/3456
Samir Ortiz: I will add a unit test in `tokenizers/tests/test_specials.py` that loads exported q8 artifacts and ensures required sentinels `["<SYS>", "</SYS>", "<RESP>"]` are present. Also adding CI gating for quant exports.
Riley Torres: I'm re-running the quant export without `--strip-specials` and pushing a new artifact to staging, will report back with a hash.
Mia Chen: Thanks — if that fixes it we can unflake the CI job and revert the temporary `encode_bytes` fallback.
Aron Patel: Also flagging: collate should log the offending template line and request id when it fails, so we can triage faster. Small PR incoming.
Mia Chen: OK everyone, re-run results: `staging/sylph4b-q8n@sha256:0a1b2c3d` includes special tokens, CI green locally. Will kick off upstream eval. :thumbsup:
Samir Ortiz: Nice. We'll follow up with a short blameless postmortem in eng-ml about export defaults and template contracts.
Mia Chen: Filing the follow-up doc now. Thanks y'all.
